name: Data Center National (Anoumambo/AIGF)
notes: Sovereign national data center at AIGF site (Anoumambo, Abidjan); first stone 2023-12-14; ~36bn FCFA (~US$60m) with US/EXIM support (Cybastion); 20,000 m2, 2x400 racks, ~1 MW, >2,200 Tbit storage per ministry statements; keep construction until ministry/operator confirms go-live.

name: PAIX Abidjan ABJ1 (Cocody/Bonoumin)
notes: Carrier-neutral colo in Cocody Bonoumin; PeeringDB fac/6246 confirms existence (A-); ~900 m2, 2 MW, ~240 racks, ISO 27001 & PCI DSS per directory (C); JV with NSIA Technologies; PAIX official location page currently 404s.

name: MTN CI eCentre (Yopougon)
notes: Modular next-generation telecom data centre (Flexenclosure eCentre) at MTN CI, Yopougon; inaugurated ~2016; telecom-internal facility; MTN Business external colo/cloud unverified.

name: CenterServ Abidjan
notes: Local colocation/dedicated-server operator in Abidjan serving SMEs; directory-listed (C); verify on official page/IDU for A-grade.

name: Raxio CIV1 (VITIB, Grand-Bassam)
notes: First Uptime Tier III certified carrier/cloud-neutral DC in CI, inside VITIB free zone, Grand-Bassam (Comoe district, 30 km from Abidjan); inaugurated Sept 2024; 3 MW IT, 2,000 m2 white space, 400 racks current / 800 full build-out (12,000 m2 site per ministry).

name: Equinix/MainOne AB1 (VITIB, Grand-Bassam)
notes: First MDXi/MainOne CI data centre at VITIB free zone, Grand Bassam (Comoe); PeeringDB fac/12168 lists VITIB Grand Bassam; Tier III standards; cable-landing-adjacent; Equinix acquired MainOne ($320m, closed 2022).

name: Equinix/MainOne AB1.2 (VITIB, Grand-Bassam)
notes: Expanded open-access carrier-neutral DC launched Nov 2023 at VITIB Grand Bassam; Uptime Tier III standards; complements AB1 on same campus.

name: ST Digital CIV01 / CloudStore (VITIB, Grand-Bassam)
notes: Inaugurated 2025-10-02 in VITIB free zone, Grand-Bassam; Tier III design/claims (no Uptime record); ~4,000 m2 building, ~160 racks; sovereign-cloud CloudStore platform; PeeringDB fac/15646.

name: Orange CI data center (Grand-Bassam)
notes: Orange CI datacenter in Grand-Bassam offering cloud/colocation; model for solar-powered DCs (half of energy needs from solar); exact address unverified - needs Orange official page/ARTCI/CIE confirmation.

name: Ministere du Budget mutualized DR data center (Yamoussoukro)
developer: Ministere du Budget et du Portefeuille de l'Etat
notes: Mutualized disaster-recovery data center in Yamoussoukro, operational since 2021-07-26, supporting business-continuity plans of ministry DGs; public-sector facility.

name: Orange CI data center (Assabou, Yamoussoukro)
notes: Orange CI datacenter at Assabou (Yamoussoukro) being solarized to cover >46% of daytime consumption; telco internal facility.
